docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Meghadūta of Kālidāsa (about the fifth century), the model of the Sanskrit messenger poem (sandeśa-kāvya), in its two parts: the Pūrvamegha, the cloud’s journey north from Rāmagiri over the rivers, hills and cities of central India to the Himālaya, and the Uttaramegha, the city of Alakā and the message itself. The text is in the mandākrāntā metre throughout.

From Wikisource · Public domain
